brief: My balcony is full shade with low moisture, and one cat lives in the household. A pitch-black north balcony with dry wind-blown soil and a cat who sits in the corner all day.

result.relaxation_note: moisture constraint relaxed because no species matched strictly

design.site_summary: A fully shaded, pet-friendly microclimate designed to safely accommodate a curious cat.
design.layout_strategy: Hanging trailing plants at eye level on the upper wall bracket, upright foliage perennials at mid height inside the main floor planters, and low-lying safe greens along the pet-accessible floor edge.
design.combination_logic: The combination contrasts the fine arching foliage of the spider plant with the bold glossy fronds of the cast iron plant and soft fern textures, creating a lush multi-tiered green display that evolves continuously through seasonal growth without any toxic risk.

zones.placement: on the east-facing hanging bracket, receiving 2 hours of gentle morning sun in full shade, sheltered from harsh wind.

plants.why: Provides a vigorous trailing habit ideally suited for a hanging vertical zone.
plants.role_in_combination: Contributes bright arching foliage that cascades down from above, creating a dynamic vertical contrast to the upright plants below.

maintenance: Check soil moisture daily during peak summer.
Water thoroughly twice a week in summer, weekly in spring and autumn.
Prune away any brown tips in early spring.

zones.placement: against the shaded north wall, receiving indirect ambient light all day in full shade.

plants.why: Stands resiliently as a durable focal point in deep shade.
plants.role_in_combination: Offers bold, dark green vertical structure that anchors the middle layer and contrasts with finer fern fronds.

plants.why: Adds elegant height and textural variation at mid-level.
plants.role_in_combination: Provides soft, feathery tropical texture that lightens the heavier visual mass of the cast iron plant.

maintenance: Water every 7 to 10 days when the top two inches of soil are dry.
Wipe broad leaves monthly with a damp cloth to remove dust.
Feed with half-strength balanced liquid fertilizer monthly in spring and summer.

zones.placement: directly on the floor along the accessible balcony edge, receiving dappled light in full shade.

plants.why: Completely non-toxic and safe for curious pets to brush against.
plants.role_in_combination: Delivers finely divided, lush green fronds at ground level that invite safe sensory interaction for pets.

maintenance: Keep the soil consistently moist but never waterlogged.
Water every 5 to 7 days in summer and every 10 days in winter.
Remove old fronds at the base in early spring.

care_instructions.frequency: Twice a week in summer, weekly in spring and autumn

care_instructions.task: Check soil moisture across all containers
Apply balanced organic liquid fertilizer to mid-level foliage

care_cautions: Overwatering the hanging Chlorophytum comosum basket can lead to root rot if drainage holes are blocked.
The ground-level Asplenium bulbiferum may experience frond tip burn if exposed to drying indoor heating vents in winter.
Deep shade conditions mean Aspidistra elatior requires less frequent watering to prevent soggy soil.
design.pet_safety_note: Every plant selected is 100% non-toxic to cats and dogs, ensuring complete safety even when the pet interacts directly with the ground-level grazing zone.
